text: すこし　なついてきた　のね　しんらいが　うまれて　きたみたい

structure.jp: すこし　なついてきた　のね
structure.en: it has started to get attached a little, hasn't it

structure.jp: しんらいが　うまれて　きたみたい
structure.en: it seems trust has begun to form

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form says a change has been coming on up to now. なついてきた = 'has started to get attached'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: うまれて　きたみたい
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end means 'it seems', judging from what you see. うまれて　きたみたい = 'it seems to have started forming'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: なついてきた　のね
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives it a tone of noticing or explaining; women often use it without だ. なついてきた　のね = 'so it has started to get attached, I see'.
